limitations.title: Keep this tab open
limitations.detail: The game runs in this tab. Closing or reloading it disconnects every player until you start the session again, and a background tab the browser puts to sleep can drop them too.

limitations.title: Your games can be lost
limitations.detail: They exist only in this browser's storage, with no backup. Unless the browser grants this site persistent storage, it may delete them without asking when the disk gets full. Clearing the site's data deletes them too, and another browser, another computer or a private window doesn't have them.

limitations.title: No connections to other services
limitations.detail: A browser page may only connect to the site it came from, so addons that work with other programs or websites (for example Trilium or Obsidian notes) don't work, and nor do actions that download a file from a link.

limitations.title: Upload limits are fixed
limitations.detail: Uploads are capped at 500 MB per game for you and 100 MB per player, and can't be raised. On the local server you set them.

limitations.title: Images load slower for players
limitations.detail: There are no small previews: players download every image (maps, tokens, handouts) at full size, so on a slow connection they appear later than from the local server.

limitations.title: Host from one tab only
limitations.detail: Your games open in one tab of this site at a time. A second tab won't open them: close it and use the first one.

limitations.title: Interrupted uploads start over
limitations.detail: If this tab closes or reloads while a file is uploading (yours or a player's), it has to be uploaded again from the start. The local server continues an interrupted upload where it stopped.

limitations.title: Log in again after a reload
limitations.detail: The host keeps your login only while this tab is open.

limitations.title: Addons come from Central's registry
limitations.detail: The addons you can browse and install are the ones Central lists, downloaded through Central; another registry can't be set. An addon you have as a file still installs from the file.
